s.how: Fry 1kg chicken wings at 160C for 10 minutes, rest, then fry again at 190C until crackly. Warm 3 tbsp gochujang with 3 tbsp honey, crushed garlic and a splash of soy until glossy. Toss the wings through and scatter with sesame seeds.

Boil and mash 600g potatoes with 150g grated cheddar. Fill dumpling wrappers and pinch closed. Boil for 3 minutes until they float, drain, then fry in butter with sliced onion until golden on both sides. Serve with sour cream.

m.note: Clint's secret family farm where the team hides out
m.how: Rub 2 whole chickens with lemon, thyme, oil and salt. Roast at 200C for 75 minutes with 1.5kg potatoes and 6 carrots in the tray. Make gravy from the juices and chicken stock. Serve at a big farmhouse table with room for everyone.

w.note: the city of Sokovia lifted into the sky
w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Shape into a round and bake at 120C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Top with whipped cream, strawberries and blueberries and lift onto a tall stand.

d.note: Thor's Asgardian liquor at the party
d.how: Stir 4 tbsp honey into 250ml warm water with the juice of a lemon and a cinnamon stick. Leave to infuse for 30 minutes, then chill. Pour over ice and top with ginger beer. Not quite strong enough to knock over a god.
